pool.b.ungeduld_nach_reha_lage: I feel nothing anymore, and the doctor is still holding me back.
Rehab is almost done, only the doctor keeps me waiting.
pool.b.ungeduld_nach_reha_lage.hitzig: I have been sitting around for weeks, and the doctor keeps interfering!
I am healthy and nobody lets me play, it drives me mad!
pool.b.ungeduld_nach_reha_lage.loyal: The team needs me, I can feel it, even though the doctor still warns.
I want to help the team again at last, but the doctor is still cautious.
pool.b.ungeduld_nach_reha_lage.ehrgeizig: Every week on the bench costs me my place, doctor or not.
I want back in the starting eleven before my rival settles in.
pool.b.ungeduld_nach_reha_lage.wechselfr: I want to play, here or elsewhere, and the doctor should not slow me down.
If I am not on the pitch soon, I will look for a club that needs me.
pool.b.ungeduld_nach_reha_lage.sensibel: I feel pushed aside since my injury, and the doctor does not make it better.

pool.b.kritik_oeffentlich_lage: The paper tore me apart after the last match.
Since the press report I get stared at in the street.
pool.b.kritik_oeffentlich_lage.hitzig: They paraded me in the paper and everyone is watching!
What they write about me is outrageous, and nobody sets it straight!
pool.b.kritik_oeffentlich_lage.loyal: I never said a bad word about the club, and now my name is on the pillory.
I accept criticism, but I did not want to read it so publicly.
pool.b.kritik_oeffentlich_lage.ehrgeizig: I know I must be better, but that slating was over the top.
I want to prove myself by performing, but the headline follows me until then.
pool.b.kritik_oeffentlich_lage.wechselfr: Elsewhere they would not have dragged me through the mud like this.

pool.b.kritik_oeffentlich_lage.sensibel: The articles kept me awake, every line stays with me.

pool.b.berater_druck_wechsel_lage: There are several offers for {name}, and my patience is not endless.

pool.b.berater_druck_wechsel_lage.hitzig: {name} is furious and wants something to happen at last, or he signs elsewhere!

pool.b.berater_druck_wechsel_lage.loyal: {name} would like to stay, but the situation hardly leaves him a choice.

pool.b.berater_druck_wechsel_lage.ehrgei: {name} wants to take the next career step, and the offers provide it.

pool.b.berater_druck_wechsel_lage.wechse: {name} is long since in his head with the other clubs courting him.

pool.b.berater_druck_wechsel_lage.sensib: {name} does not feel valued and asked me to sort this out.

pool.b.berater_druck_wechsel_gruss: Good day, this is the agent of {name}.
